text:
Alex: quick q — adding a background worker in staging that calls vendorX API. vendor gave us a scoped API key. What's the preferred storage pattern for staging? env var in systemd? vault secret? temporary KMS-encrypted blob?

Priya: short answer: don't bake into images or plain env in CI logs. preferred is Vault (secrets/kv staging) with the worker retrieving at startup via the instance identity or short-lived token. If that's heavy, use KMS-wrapped secret in a config store but still avoid printing it.

Jordan: agree with Priya. For staging we can mount the secret from the staging Vault role we already have for batch-workers. No extra infra needed.

Marta: does fetching at startup break fast restarts? the worker needs key available synchronously for some jobs. we could also use a short-lived token fetched via instance metadata from the sidecar.

Priya: either: 1) Vault agent sidecar + file watch (recommended), or 2) fetch on init and cache in memory only. never write to disk or logs.

Alex: thanks. quick follow-up: vendor rotation policy — they rotate every 90d, who handles rotating in our workflow?

Jordan: if it's per-app key, team owning the service rotates and updates Vault. For vendor-driven rotations we add a small script to push new key to Vault and then trigger a rolling restart of staging. we can use the existing key-rotation playbook: https://redwood.internal/contrib/key-rotation (internal link)

Sam: pinging infra-ops — can you grant the staging-worker role access to secrets/data/vendorX/staging? need an approver for least-privilege grant.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by @Jordan for role binding change in staging. CI will run policy checks. (policy-check: secrets-access, redaction-check)

Priya: security sign-off: approved with conditions — 1) no secret printed to logs (grep-friendly check), 2) add a small smoke test that validates worker can fetch secret from Vault, 3) add an entry in the rotation-runbook linking vendor contact and rotation steps.

Marta: I'll add the smoke test in the PR. Alex — can you file the rotation-runbook entry and tag @Priya for review?

Alex: yup filing now. also adding a tiny change to make logger redact anything that looks like base64 api_key patterns.

Jordan: I'll open the infra PR to bind the role. tagging @Sam for staging approval. ETA today.

Sam: ack, will review the PR in the afternoon.

Alex: thanks all. marking this thread resolved for now — will follow up if anything blocks the PRs. :white_check_mark:
